items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: Willie had a picture where he played with Buddy Bolden and them.

ctx.x: Do you remember Mr. Carnage? My husband.

He was talking about how nice he could play. I said, oh yeah. That's what they're talking about. Yeah. That's him, man. That's all I got. That's a picture of him. I got my specs. I don't know what's the matter with me with them specs today. The picture, what they want, you see, Willie had a picture where he played with Buddy Bolden and them. He saw it. And the man who took it downtown in St. Benard, he tells me he died. And they said they're going to secretly search it up. That's the only picture I had. If we…
We can make a copy sometime, I'm sure.
